root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = _V3new(0, vy, 0)
end
end
if autoRightSetVisual then autoRightSetVisual(false) end
if mobSetAutoRight then mobSetAutoRight(false) end
_unsuppressBodyLock(true)
end

function startAutoRight()
if autoLeftEnabled then
autoLeftEnabled = false
stopAutoLeft()
if autoLeftSetVisual then autoLeftSetVisual(false) end
if mobSetAutoLeft then mobSetAutoLeft(false) end
end
autoRightEnabled = true
disableAllAimbots()
_suppressBodyLock()
if arConn then arConn:Disconnect(); arConn = nil end
arPhase = 1
arConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
if not autoRightEnabled then return end
local char = LP.Character
if not char then return end
local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
local spd = getAutoPathSpeed and getAutoPathSpeed() or NS
local target = (arPhase == 1) and AP.R1 or AP.R2
local tgt = _V3new(target.X, root.Position.Y, target.Z)
local mv, dist = _autoPathDir(root.Position, tgt)
if arPhase == 1 then
if dist < 1.5 then
arPhase = 2
target = AP.R2
tgt = _V3new(target.X, root.Position.Y, target.Z)
mv, dist = _autoPathDir(root.Position, tgt)
end
elseif arPhase == 2 then
if dist < 1.5 then
hum:Move(_V3zero, false)
local vy = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = _V3new(0, vy, 0)
autoRightEnabled = false
if arConn then arConn:Disconnect(); arConn = nil end
arPhase = 1
if autoRightSetVisual then autoRightSetVisual(false) end
if mobSetAutoRight then mobSetAutoRight(false) end
_unsuppressBodyLock(true)
local facePos = _V3new(AP.R_FACE.X, root.Position.Y, AP.R_FACE.Z)
if (facePos - root.Position).Magnitude > 0.05 then
root.CFrame = _CFnew(root.Position, facePos)
end
return
end
end
if mv then
hum:Move(mv, false)
_applyVelocitySpeed(mv, spd, root)
if CarrySystem and CarrySystem._lvBoost and CarrySystem._lvBoost.Parent == root then
CarrySystem._lvBoost.PlaneVelocity = Vector2.new(mv.X * spd, mv.Z * spd)
end
end
end)
end

-- ==================== AIMBOT HARDENED V3 (Bubble core + sticky) ====================
-- Normal (autoBat) and Bat Bypass share the same proven tracking core.
-- Orbit tight, height low, swing aggressive, no overshoot.

local AIM_CFG = {
	FOLLOW_SPEED = 62,
	ACTIVATE_DISTANCE = 10.5,
	MIN_FOLLOW_DISTANCE = 0.55,
	PREDICTION_TIME = 0.18,
	PREDICT_AHEAD = 0.9,
	MAX_VELOCITY_CHANGE = 200,
	VELOCITY_SMOOTHING = 0.38,
	MAX_HORIZONTAL_VELOCITY = 105,
	SERVER_TICKRATE = 1 / 60,
	MIN_PING_COMPENSATION = 0.035,
	MAX_PING_COMPENSATION = 0.35,
	ACCELERATION_PREDICTION_WEIGHT = 0.4,
	DIRECTION_CHANGE_DETECTION_TIME = 0.12,
	QUICK_DIRECTION_CHANGE_MULTIPLIER = 1.6,
	GRAVITY = 196.2,
	AIR_CONTROL_FACTOR = 0.88,
	MIN_AIRBORNE_TIME = 0.05,
	SWING_COOLDOWN = 0.06,
	ORBIT_RADIUS = 0.9,
	ORBIT_HEIGHT = 0.4,
	TURN_RATE = 52,
	STICKY_TIME = 0.6,
	RETARGET_RATIO = 0.7,
	CLOSE_SLOW = 0.72,
	FAR_BOOST = 1.12,
}

local _aimShared = {
	stickyRoot = nil,
	stickyUntil = 0,
	lastTargetPos = nil,
	targetVelocity = Vector3.zero,
	smoothedVelocity = Vector3.zero,
	velocityHistory = {},
	accelerationHistory = {},
	aerialVelocityHistory = {},
	previousDirection = nil,
	lastDirectionChangeTime = 0,
	airborneTime = 0,
	lastActivationTime = 0,
	currentPing = 0.08,
	realPingMs = 60,
	lastPingCheck = 0,
}

local function _aimAvg(list)
	if #list == 0 then return Vector3.zero end
	local s = Vector3.zero
	for _, v in ipairs(list) do s = s + v end
	return s / #list
end

local function _aimPush(list, value, maxn)
	table.insert(list, value)
	if #list > maxn then table.remove(list, 1) end
end

local function _aimSamplePing()
	local now = tick()
	if now - (_aimShared.lastPingCheck or 0) < 0.35 then return end
	_aimShared.lastPingCheck = now
	local ok, v = pcall(function()
		return game:GetService("Stats").Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()
	end)
	if ok and type(v) == "number" then
		_aimShared.realPingMs = math.floor(v)
	else
		pcall(function() _aimShared.realPingMs = math.floor((LP:GetNetworkPing() or 0.06) * 1000) end)
	end
	_aimShared.currentPing = math.clamp(
		(_aimShared.realPingMs or 60) / 1000,
		AIM_CFG.MIN_PING_COMPENSATION,
		AIM_CFG.MAX_PING_COMPENSATION
	)
end

local function _aimResetTrack()
	local A = _aimShared
	A.lastTargetPos = nil
	A.targetVelocity = Vector3.zero
	A.smoothedVelocity = Vector3.zero
	A.velocityHistory = {}
	A.accelerationHistory = {}
	A.aerialVelocityHistory = {}
	A.previousDirection = nil
	A.airborneTime = 0
end

function getClosestTarget()
	local char = LP.Character
	if not char then return nil end
	local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return nil end
	local rpos = root.Position
	local now = tick()
	local A = _aimShared

	-- sticky
	if A.stickyRoot and now < A.stickyUntil then
		local st = A.stickyRoot
		if st.Parent then
			local hum = st.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
				local d = (st.Position - rpos).Magnitude
				if d < 30 then return st end
			end
		end
	end

	local closest, minDist = nil, math.huge
	local plist = (_GetPlayersCached and _GetPlayersCached()) or Players:GetPlayers()
	for i = 1, #plist do
		local plr = plist[i]
		if plr ~= LP then
			local c = plr.Character
			if c then
				local tRoot = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local hum = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if tRoot and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
					local d = (tRoot.Position - rpos).Magnitude
					if d < minDist then
						minDist = d
						closest = tRoot
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- only retarget if clearly closer
	if A.stickyRoot and closest and A.stickyRoot ~= closest and now < A.stickyUntil then
		local oldD = (A.stickyRoot.Position - rpos).Magnitude
		if minDist > oldD * AIM_CFG.RETARGET_RATIO then
			return A.stickyRoot
		end
	end

	if closest then
		if A.stickyRoot ~= closest then
			_aimResetTrack()
		end
		A.stickyRoot = closest
		A.stickyUntil = now + AIM_CFG.STICKY_TIME
	end
	return closest
end

local function _aimFindBat(char)
	if not char then return nil end
	if findBat then
		local b = findBat()
		if b then return b end
	end
	for _, container in ipairs({char, LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")}) do
		if container then
			for _, tool in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
				if tool:IsA("Tool") then
					local n = tool.Name:lower()
					if n:find("bat", 1, true) or n:find("slap", 1, true)
						or n:find("sword", 1, true) or n:find("knife", 1, true) then
						return tool
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function _aimFireBat(bat)
	if not bat then return end
	pcall(function() bat:Activate() end)
	pcall(function()
		for _, d in ipairs(bat:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
				d:FireServer()
				break
			end
		end
	end)
end

function trySwing()
	local now = tick()
	if now - (_aimShared.lastActivationTime or 0) < AIM_CFG.SWING_COOLDOWN then return end
	_aimShared.lastActivationTime = now
	local char = LP.Character
	if not char then return end
	local bat = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or _aimFindBat(char)
	if not bat then return end
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if bat.Parent ~= char and hum then
		pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(bat) end)
	end
	_aimFireBat(bat)
end

local function _aimLookAt(root, direction)
	if direction.Magnitude < 0.05 then return end
	local flat = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude < 0.05 then return end
	local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
	local flatLook = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
	if flatLook.Magnitude < 0.01 then flatLook = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
	flatLook = flatLook.Unit
	local axis = flatLook:Cross(flat.Unit)
	local dot = math.clamp(flatLook:Dot(flat.Unit), -1, 1)
	local angle = math.acos(dot)
	if axis.Magnitude > 0.01 and angle > 0.02 then
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = axis.Unit * math.clamp(angle * AIM_CFG.TURN_RATE, -26, 26)
	else
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end
end

-- core step used by both normal and bat bypass
local function _aimCoreStep(dt, speedValue, activateDist)
	_aimSamplePing()
	local char = LP.Character
	if not char then return end
	local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
	hum.AutoRotate = false

	local bat = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or _aimFindBat(char)
	if bat and bat.Parent ~= char then
		pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(bat) end)
	end

	local targetRoot = getClosestTarget()
	if not targetRoot then
		_aimResetTrack()
		return
	end
	local targetHum = targetRoot.Parent and targetRoot.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not targetHum or targetHum.Health <= 0 then
		_aimResetTrack()
		return
	end

	local A = _aimShared
	local CFG = AIM_CFG
	local targetPos = targetRoot.Position
	local myPos = root.Position
	local distNow = (targetPos - myPos).Magnitude
	local safeDt = math.max(dt, 1 / 240)

	-- velocity sample
	if A.lastTargetPos then
		local raw = (targetPos - A.lastTargetPos) / safeDt
		local delta = raw - A.targetVelocity
		if delta.Magnitude > CFG.MAX_VELOCITY_CHANGE then
			raw = A.targetVelocity + delta.Unit * CFG.MAX_VELOCITY_CHANGE
		end
		local horiz = Vector3.new(raw.X, 0, raw.Z)
		if horiz.Magnitude > CFG.MAX_HORIZONTAL_VELOCITY then
			horiz = horiz.Unit * CFG.MAX_HORIZONTAL_VELOCITY
			raw = Vector3.new(horiz.X, raw.Y, horiz.Z)
		end
		_aimPush(A.accelerationHistory, (raw - A.targetVelocity) / safeDt, 5)
		_aimPush(A.velocityHistory, raw, 8)
		A.targetVelocity = raw
		A.smoothedVelocity = A.smoothedVelocity:Lerp(raw, CFG.VELOCITY_SMOOTHING)
	end
	A.lastTargetPos = targetPos

	local airborne = targetHum.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air
	A.airborneTime = airborne and (A.airborneTime + safeDt) or 0
	if airborne and A.airborneTime >= CFG.MIN_AIRBORNE_TIME then
		_aimPush(A.aerialVelocityHistory, A.targetVelocity, 6)
	elseif not airborne then
		A.aerialVelocityHistory = {}
	end

	local predVel = A.smoothedVelocity
	if airborne and #A.aerialVelocityHistory > 0 then
		local avgAir = _aimAvg(A.aerialVelocityHistory)
		predVel = Vector3.new(avgAir.X, A.targetVelocity.Y, avgAir.Z) * CFG.AIR_CONTROL_FACTOR
	end

	local quickTurn = false
	local hVel = Vector3.new(A.targetVelocity.X, 0, A.targetVelocity.Z)
	if hVel.Magnitude > 5 then
		local dir = hVel.Unit
		if A.previousDirection and A.previousDirection:Dot(dir) < 0.45 then
			quickTurn = tick() - (A.lastDirectionChangeTime or 0) < CFG.DIRECTION_CHANGE_DETECTION_TIME
			A.lastDirectionChangeTime = tick()
		end
		A.previousDirection = dir
	end

	local lead = (A.currentPing or 0.08) + CFG.SERVER_TICKRATE + CFG.PREDICTION_TIME * 0.35
	if quickTurn then lead = lead * CFG.QUICK_DIRECTION_CHANGE_MULTIPLIER end

	local predicted = targetPos + predVel * lead
	local accel = _aimAvg(A.accelerationHistory)
	predicted = predicted + accel * CFG.ACCELERATION_PREDICTION_WEIGHT * (lead * lead * 0.5)
	if airborne then
		predicted = predicted + Vector3.new(0, -0.5 * CFG.GRAVITY * lead * lead, 0)
	end
	local horizPred = Vector3.new(predVel.X, 0, predVel.Z)
	if horizPred.Magnitude > 1 then
		predicted = predicted + horizPred.Unit * CFG.PREDICT_AHEAD
	end

	-- tight orbit toward us (critical for slap connect)
	local toMe = myPos - targetPos
	local flatToMe = Vector3.new(toMe.X, 0, toMe.Z)
	local orbitR = CFG.ORBIT_RADIUS
	local orbitH = CFG.ORBIT_HEIGHT
	if flatToMe.Magnitude > 0.15 then
		predicted = predicted + flatToMe.Unit * orbitR
	end
	predicted = Vector3.new(predicted.X, targetPos.Y + orbitH, predicted.Z)

	local goal = predicted - myPos
	_aimLookAt(root, goal)

	-- swing
	local actDist = activateDist or CFG.ACTIVATE_DISTANCE
	if distNow <= actDist and tick() - (A.lastActivationTime or 0) >= CFG.SWING_COOLDOWN then
		_aimFireBat(bat)
		A.lastActivationTime = tick()
		if distNow <= 4.5 then
			task.delay(0.035, function()
				if autoBatEnabled or autoBatBypassEnabled then
					local c2 = LP.Character
					local b2 = c2 and (c2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or _aimFindBat(c2))
					_aimFireBat(b2)
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	-- movement: flat chase + soft Y, slow when already on target
	local followSpeed = math.clamp(tonumber(speedValue) or CFG.FOLLOW_SPEED, 1, 130)
	local speedMul = 1
	if distNow > 18 then
		speedMul = CFG.FAR_BOOST
	elseif distNow < orbitR + 1.8 then
		speedMul = CFG.CLOSE_SLOW
	end
	local speed = followSpeed * speedMul
	local flatGoal = Vector3.new(goal.X, 0, goal.Z)
	local vy = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
	if math.abs(goal.Y) > 1.5 then
		vy = math.clamp(goal.Y * 5.8, -speed, speed)
	end

	if flatGoal.Magnitude > CFG.MIN_FOLLOW_DISTANCE then
		local moveDir = flatGoal.Unit
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(moveDir.X * speed, vy, moveDir.Z * speed)
	else
		-- park on them, keep slight Y so you don't sink
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, vy * 0.35, 0)
	end
end


-- ==================== VX7 BAT AIMBOT (Normal AutoBat) ====================
-- LinearVelocity mover + velocity prediction. Replaces blood normal core path.
local _vxBat = {
	connection = nil,
	attachmentName = "BH_VX7AimbotAttach",
	moverName = "BH_VX7AimbotMover",
	minForce = 1000000,
	maxForce = 50000000,
	pred = {},
}

function _vxBat.getBat()
	local character = LP.Character
	if not character then return nil end
	for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Tool") then
			local n = child.Name:lower()
			if n:find("bat") or n:find("slap") then return child end
		end
	end
	local bp = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if bp then
		for _, child in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Tool") then
				local n = child.Name:lower()
				if n:find("bat") or n:find("slap") then return child end
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function _vxBat.nearestTarget(fromRoot)
	local best, bestDist = nil, _huge
	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if plr ~= LP then
			local char = plr.Character
			local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
				local d = (hrp.Position - fromRoot.Position).Magnitude
				if d < bestDist then
					bestDist = d
					best = hrp
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

function _vxBat.clearMover(root)
	root = root or (LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
	if not root then return end
	local m = root:FindFirstChild(_vxBat.moverName)
	local a = root:FindFirstChild(_vxBat.attachmentName)
	if m and m:IsA("LinearVelocity") then m:Destroy() end
	if a and a:IsA("Attachment") then a:Destroy() end
end

function _vxBat.ensureMover(parent, speed)
	local attachment = parent:FindFirstChild(_vxBat.attachmentName)
	if attachment and not attachment:IsA("Attachment") then
		attachment:Destroy()
		attachment = nil
	end
	if not attachment then
		attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
		attachment.Name = _vxBat.attachmentName
		attachment.Parent = parent
	end
	local lv = parent:FindFirstChild(_vxBat.moverName)
	if not lv or not lv:IsA("LinearVelocity") then
		if lv then lv:Destroy() end
		lv = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
		lv.Name = _vxBat.moverName
		lv.Attachment0 = attachment
		lv.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
		lv.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector
		lv.ForceLimitsEnabled = true
		lv.ForceLimitMode = Enum.ForceLimitMode.PerAxis
		lv.VectorVelocity = _V3zero
		lv.Parent = parent
	else
		lv.Attachment0 = attachment
	end
	local force = math.clamp(parent.AssemblyMass * math.max(speed * 220, 6000), _vxBat.minForce, _vxBat.maxForce)
	lv.MaxAxesForce = _V3new(force, force, force)
	lv.Enabled = true
	return lv
end

function _vxBat.applyMove(root, desiredVel, speed, dt)
	local lv = _vxBat.ensureMover(root, speed)
	local alpha = 1 - math.exp(-math.max(dt or 0.016666666666666666, 0) * 26)
	lv.VectorVelocity = lv.VectorVelocity:Lerp(desiredVel, alpha)
end

function _vxBat.resetMotion()
	local char = LP.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if root then
		_vxBat.clearMover(root)
		root.Anchored = false
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = _V3zero
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = _V3zero
		if sethiddenproperty then
			pcall(sethiddenproperty, root, "PhysicsRepRootPart", nil)
		end
		local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
		local flat = _V3new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
		flat = flat.Magnitude > 0.01 and flat.Unit or _V3new(0, 0, -1)
		root.CFrame = _CFlookAt(root.Position, root.Position + flat)
	end
	if hum then
		hum.AutoRotate = true
		hum.PlatformStand = false
		pcall(function() hum:Move(_V3zero, false) end)
		pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end)
	end
end

function _vxBat.update(dt)
	if not autoBatEnabled then return end
	local char = LP.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not char or not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

	local target = _vxBat.nearestTarget(root)
	if not target then
		hum.AutoRotate = true
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = _V3zero
		_vxBat.clearMover(root)
		return
	end

	local speed = math.clamp(tonumber(BAT_AIMBOT_SPEED) or 62, 1, 500)
	hum.AutoRotate = false

	local now = _tick()
	local pred = _vxBat.pred
	local entry = pred[target]
	local vel
	if not entry then
		pred[target] = { pos = target.Position, time = now, vel = _V3zero }
		vel = _V3zero
	else
		local dtPred = math.clamp(now - entry.time, 0.008333333333333333, 0.25)
		local raw = (target.Position - entry.pos) / dtPred
		if raw.Magnitude > 80 then raw = raw.Unit * 80 end
		entry.vel = entry.vel:Lerp(raw, 0.25)
		entry.pos = target.Position
		entry.time = now
		vel = entry.vel
	end

	-- predicted aim point (vx7)
	local aimPoint = target.Position + vel * math.clamp(vel.Magnitude / 130, 0.05, 0.12) + _V3new(0, 1, 0)
	local toAim = aimPoint - root.Position
	local dir = toAim.Magnitude > 0.01 and toAim.Unit or _V3zero
	local flatTo = _V3new(toAim.X, 0, toAim.Z)

	if toAim.Magnitude > 0.01 and flatTo.Magnitude > 0.01 then
		local yawErr = (math.deg(math.atan2(-flatTo.X, -flatTo.Z)) - root.Orientation.Y + 180) % 360 - 180
		local pitchErr = (math.deg(math.atan2(toAim.Y, flatTo.Magnitude)) - root.Orientation.X + 180) % 360 - 180
		local yawVel = math.clamp(math.rad(yawErr) * 285, -28, 28)
		local pitchVel = math.clamp(math.rad(pitchErr) * 285, -28, 28)
		local yaw = math.rad(root.Orientation.Y)
		local right = _V3new(math.cos(yaw), 0, -math.sin(yaw))
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = _V3new(0, yawVel, 0) + right * pitchVel
	else
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = _V3zero
	end

	-- stand slightly past target (vx7 offset)
	local chase = aimPoint - dir * -2.8 + _V3new(0, 4.75, 0) - root.Position
	local flatChase = _V3new(chase.X, 0, chase.Z)
	local horiz = flatChase.Magnitude > 0.1 and flatChase.Unit * speed or _V3zero
	local vert = math.abs(chase.Y) > 0.1 and _V3new(0, math.sign(chase.Y) * 52, 0) or _V3new(0, -2, 0)
	_vxBat.applyMove(root, horiz + vert, speed, dt)

	if flatChase.Magnitude > 0.5 then
		hum:Move(flatChase.Unit, false)
	end

	-- always swing when close (blood behavior)
	local dist = (target.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
	if dist <= 11 then
		local bat = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or _vxBat.getBat()
		if bat then
			if bat.Parent ~= char then
				pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(bat) end)
			end
			pcall(function() bat:Activate() end)
			local ev = bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent")
			if ev then pcall(function() ev:FireServer() end) end
		end
	end
end

function _vxBat.start()
	if _vxBat.connection then return end
	_vxBat.pred = {}
	local char = LP.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if char and hum and not char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") then
		local bat = _vxBat.getBat()
		if bat and bat.Parent ~= char then
			pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(bat) end)
		end
	end
	_vxBat.clearMover()
	_vxBat.connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(_vxBat.update)
end

function _vxBat.stop()
	if _vxBat.connection then
		_vxBat.connection:Disconnect()
		_vxBat.connection = nil
	end
	_vxBat.resetMotion()
	_vxBat.pred = {}
end


function stopAimbotAdapt()
	if _batV1BypassRunning then
		_batV1BypassRunning = false
		pcall(function() if _G.BlastAimbotV4 then _G.BlastAimbotV4.Stop() end end)
	end
	if _aimbotConn then
		pcall(function() _aimbotConn:Disconnect() end)
		_aimbotConn = nil
	end
	pcall(function() _vxBat.stop() end)
	local char = LP.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum then
		hum.AutoRotate = (_prevAutoRotate == nil) and true or _prevAutoRotate
		hum.PlatformStand = false
		pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end)
	end
	if root then
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = _V3new(0, -0.1, 0)
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = _V3zero
	end
	_prevAutoRotate = nil
	lastMoveDir = _V3zero
	_aimShared.stickyRoot = nil
	_aimShared.stickyUntil = 0
	_aimResetTrack()
	if _unsuppressBodyLock then _unsuppressBodyLock(true) end
end

function startAimbotAdapt()
	if batV1Bypass and _G.BlastAimbotV4 then
		_batV1BypassRunning = true
		_G.BlastAimbotV4.Start()
		return
	end
	if _aimbotConn then
		pcall(function() _aimbotConn:Disconnect() end)
		_aimbotConn = nil
	end
	if _suppressBodyLock then _suppressBodyLock() end
	local hum0 = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum0 then
		if _prevAutoRotate == nil then _prevAutoRotate = hum0.AutoRotate end
		hum0.AutoRotate = false
	end
	_aimResetTrack()
	-- VX7 LinearVelocity aimbot (normal bat)
	_vxBat.start()
end

function disableAutoBat()
	autoBatEnabled = false
	if autoBatSetVisual then autoBatSetVisual(false) end
	if mobSetAutoBat then mobSetAutoBat(false) end
	stopAimbotAdapt()
end

function enableAutoBat()
	if autoLeftEnabled then
		autoLeftEnabled = false
		if autoLeftSetVisual then autoLeftSetVisual(false) end
		stopAutoLeft()
	end
	if autoRightEnabled then
		autoRightEnabled = false
		if autoRightSetVisual then autoRightSetVisual(false) end
		stopAutoRight()
	end
	if autoBatBypassEnabled then disableBatBypass() end
	autoBatEnabled = true
	if autoBatSetVisual then autoBatSetVisual(true) end
	if mobSetAutoBat then mobSetAutoBat(true) end
	startAimbotAdapt()
end


-- ==================== BAT BYPASS (same core, slightly wider activate) ====================
local _zurichConnV2 = nil
local _prevAutoRotateZurichV2 = nil
local _zurichPingLoopId = 0
batBypassVersion = (batBypassVersion == 3) and 3 or ((batBypassVersion == 2) and 2 or 1)

function startBatBypassAimbot()
	if _zurichConnV2 then return end
	if _suppressBodyLock then _suppressBodyLock() end
	_aimResetTrack()
	_aimShared.lastActivationTime = 0
	local hum0 = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum0 then
		if _prevAutoRotateZurichV2 == nil then _prevAutoRotateZurichV2 = hum0.AutoRotate end
		hum0.AutoRotate = false
		local bat = _aimFindBat(LP.Character)
		if bat and bat.Parent ~= LP.Character then
			pcall(function() hum0:EquipTool(bat) end)
		end
	end
	_zurichConnV2 = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		if not autoBatBypassEnabled then return end
		local spd = tonumber(BAT_AIMBOT_SPEED) or AIM_CFG.FOLLOW_SPEED
		_aimCoreStep(dt, spd, 11.5)
	end)
	_batBypassConn = _zurichConnV2
end

function stopBatBypassAimbot()
	_zurichPingLoopId = _zurichPingLoopId + 1
	if _zurichConnV2 then
		_zurichConnV2:Disconnect()
		_zurichConnV2 = nil
	end
	if _batBypassConn then
		pcall(function() _batBypassConn:Disconnect() end)
		_batBypassConn = nil
	end
	_aimResetTrack()
	_aimShared.lastActivationTime = 0
	local c = LP.Character
	local root = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum then
		hum.AutoRotate = (_prevAutoRotateZurichV2 == nil) and true or _prevAutoRotateZurichV2
		hum.PlatformStand = false
		pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end)
	end
	if root then
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end
	_prevAutoRotateZurichV2 = nil
	if _unsuppressBodyLock then _unsuppressBodyLock(true) end
	autoBatBypassHitCooldown = false
end

function enableBatBypass()
	if autoBatBypassEnabled then return end
	if batBypassVersion == 3 then
		if autoBatV3Enabled then
			autoBatBypassEnabled = true
			if autoBatBypassSetVisual then autoBatBypassSetVisual(true) end
			return
		end
		if autoBatEnabled then disableAutoBat() end
		autoBatBypassEnabled = true
		enableBatV3()
		if autoBatBypassSetVisual then autoBatBypassSetVisual(true) end
		if batBypassFloatingButton then
			local btnFrame = batBypassFloatingButton:FindFirstChild("Frame")
			if btnFrame then paintFloatingBtn(btnFrame, true) end
		end
		return
	end
	if autoBatV3Enabled then disableBatV3() end
	if autoBatEnabled then disableAutoBat() end
	if autoLeftEnabled then
		autoLeftEnabled = false
		stopAutoLeft()
		if autoLeftSetVisual then autoLeftSetVisual(false) end
		if mobSetAutoLeft then mobSetAutoLeft(false) end
	end
	if autoRightEnabled then
		autoRightEnabled = false
		stopAutoRight()
		if autoRightSetVisual then autoRightSetVisual(false) end
		if mobSetAutoRight then mobSetAutoRight(false) end
	end
	autoBatBypassEnabled = true
	startBatBypassAimbot()
	if autoBatBypassSetVisual then autoBatBypassSetVisual(true) end
	if batBypassFloatingButton then
		local btnFrame = batBypassFloatingButton:FindFirstChild("Frame")
		if btnFrame then paintFloatingBtn(btnFrame, true) end
	end
end

function disableBatBypass()
	if batBypassVersion == 3 and (autoBatV3Enabled or autoBatBypassEnabled) then
		autoBatBypassEnabled = false
		if autoBatV3Enabled then disableBatV3() end
		if autoBatBypassSetVisual then autoBatBypassSetVisual(false) end
		if batBypassFloatingButton then
			local btnFrame = batBypassFloatingButton:FindFirstChild("Frame")
			if btnFrame then paintFloatingBtn(btnFrame, false) end
		end
		return
	end
	if not autoBatBypassEnabled then return end
	autoBatBypassEnabled = false
	stopBatBypassAimbot()
	if autoBatBypassSetVisual then autoBatBypassSetVisual(false) end
	if batBypassFloatingButton then
		local btnFrame = batBypassFloatingButton:FindFirstChild("Frame")
		if btnFrame then paintFloatingBtn(btnFrame, false) end
	end
end

function toggleBatBypass()
	if autoBatBypassEnabled then disableBatBypass() else enableBatBypass() end
end

function findBat()
local char = LP.Character
if not char then return nil end
for _, name in ipairs(BAT_COUNTER_SLAP_LIST) do
local t = char:FindFirstChild(name)
if t and t:IsA("Tool") then return t end
end
local bp = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
if bp then
for _, name in ipairs(BAT_COUNTER_SLAP_LIST) do
local t = bp:FindFirstChild(name)
if t and t:IsA("Tool") then
local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hum then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(t) end) end
return t
end
end
end
for _, ch in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
if ch:IsA("Tool") and (ch.Name:lower():find("bat") or ch.Name:lower():find("slap")) then
return ch
end
end
return nil
end
function isBatTool(tool)
if not tool then return false end
for _, name in ipairs(BAT_COUNTER_SLAP_LIST) do
if tool.Name == name then return true end
end
return tool.Name:lower():find("bat") or tool.Name:lower():find("slap")
end
function findBatForCounter()
local char = LP.Character
if not char then return nil end
local backpack = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
for _, name in ipairs(BAT_COUNTER_SLAP_LIST) do
local tool = char:FindFirstChild(name) or (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(name))
if tool then return tool end
end
for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
if child:IsA("Tool") and (child.Name:lower():find("bat") or child.Name:lower():find("slap")) then
return child
end
end
if backpack then
for _, child in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
if child:IsA("Tool") and (child.Name:lower():find("bat") or child.Name:lower():find("slap")) then
return child
end
end
end
return nil
end
function swingBatForCounter(bat, character)
local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if bat.Parent ~= character and humanoid then
pcall(function() humanoid:EquipTool(bat) end)
task.wait(0.05)
end
local remote = bat:FindFirstChildOfClass("RemoteEvent") or bat:FindFirstChildOfClass("RemoteFunction")
if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
pcall(function() remote:FireServer() end)
task.wait(0.1)
pcall(function() remote:FireServer() end)
else
pcall(function() bat:Activate() end)
task.wait(0.1)
pcall(function() bat:Activate() end)
end
end
batCounterDebounce = false
function stopBatCounter()
if Conns.batCounter then
Conns.batCounter:Disconnect()
Conns.batCounter = nil
end
batCounterDebounce = false
end
function startBatCounter()
if Conns.batCounter then return end
Conns.batCounter = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
if not batCounterEnabled then return end
if batCounterDebounce then return end
local character = LP.Character
if not character then return end
local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not humanoid then return end
local state = humanoid:GetState()
if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown then
batCounterDebounce = true
_suppressBodyLock()
task.spawn(function()
task.wait(0.15)
local bat = findBatForCounter()
if bat then swingBatForCounter(bat, character) end
task.wait(0.3)
batCounterDebounce = false
_unsuppressBodyLock(true)
end)
end
end)
end
function findMedusa()
local c = LP.Character
if not c then return nil end
for _, t in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
if t:IsA("Tool") then
local n = t.Name:lower()
if n:find("medusa") or n:find("head") or n:find("stone") then return t end
end
end
local bp = LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
if bp then
for _, t in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
if t:IsA("Tool") then
local n = t.Name:lower()
if n:find("medusa") or n:find("head") or n:find("stone") then return t end
end
end
end
return nil
end
function useMedusaCounter()
if medusaDebounce then return end
if _tick() - medusaLastUsed < MEDUSA_COOLDOWN then return end
local c = LP.Character
if not c then return end
medusaDebounce = true
local med = findMedusa()
if not med then medusaDebounce = false; return end
if med.Parent ~= c then
local hum2 = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hum2 then hum2:EquipTool(med) end
end
pcall(function() med:Activate() end)
medusaLastUsed = _tick()
medusaDebounce = false
end
function onAnchorChanged(part)
return part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Anchored"):Connect(function()
if medusaCounterEnabled and part.Anchored and part.Transparency == 1 then useMedusaCounter() end
end)
end
function setupMedusaCounter(char)
for _, c in pairs(Conns.anchor) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
Conns.anchor = {}
if not char or not medusaCounterEnabled then return end
for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
if part:IsA("BasePart") then
table.insert(Conns.anchor, onAnchorChanged(part))
end
end
table.insert(Conns.anchor, char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(part)
if part:IsA("BasePart") then
table.insert(Conns.anchor, onAnchorChanged(part))
end
end))
end
function stopMedusaCounter()
for _, c in pairs(Conns.anchor) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
Conns.anchor = {}
end
local DROP_ASCEND_DURATION = 0.22
local DROP_ASCEND_SPEED = 160
local _dropConn = nil
function stopDropBrainrot()
dropActive = false
if _dropConn then
_dropConn:Disconnect()
_dropConn = nil
end
for _, t in ipairs(dropConnections) do
if type(t) == "thread" then pcall(task.cancel, t)
elseif type(t) == "RBXScriptConnection" then pcall(t.Disconnect, t) end
end
dropConnections = {}
local c = LP.Character
if c then
local root = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if root then root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = _V3zero end
end
if dropBrainrotSetVisual then dropBrainrotSetVisual(false) end
if mobSetDropBR then mobSetDropBR(false) end
end
function runDropBrainrot()
if dropActive then return end
local char = LP.Character
local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not root or not hum then return end
if dropMode == 1 then
local speedH = 0
if root then
local vel = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
speedH = _V3new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude
end
local cooldown = (speedH > 5) and 0.6 or 0.25
if _tick() - lastDropTime < cooldown then return end
lastDropTime = _tick()
dropActive = true
if dropBrainrotSetVisual then dropBrainrotSetVisual(true) end
if mobSetDropBR then mobSetDropBR(true) end
local wasAutoBat = false
if autoBatEnabled then
wasAutoBat = true
disableAutoBat()
if autoBatSetVisual then autoBatSetVisual(false) end
if mobSetAutoBat then mobSetAutoBat(false) end
end
local function finishDrop(threadRef)
if threadRef and dropConnections then
for i = #dropConnections, 1, -1 do
if dropConnections[i] == threadRef then
table.remove(dropConnections, i)
break
end
end
end
dropActive = false
local c = LP.Character
if c then
local r = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local h = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if r then
r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = _V3zero
r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = _V3zero
if r.Position.Y < -100 then
r.CFrame = _CFnew(r.Position.X, 5, r.Position.Z)
end
local rp = RaycastParams.new()
rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {c}
rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
local rr = workspace:Raycast(r.Position, _V3new(0, -2000, 0), rp)
if rr then
local off = (h and h.HipHeight or 2) + (r.Size.Y / 2)
r.CFrame = _CFnew(r.Position.X, rr.Position.Y + off, r.Position.Z)
end
if h and h.Health > 0 then h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end
end
end
if wasAutoBat then
enableAutoBat()
if autoBatSetVisual then autoBatSetVisual(true) end
if mobSetAutoBat then mobSetAutoBat(true) end
end
if dropBrainrotSetVisual then dropBrainrotSetVisual(false) end
if mobSetDropBR then mobSetDropBR(false) end
end
local flingThread = nil
flingThread = task.spawn(function()
local startTime = _tick()
while dropActive and (_tick() - startTime) < 0.25 do
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
local c = LP.Character
local r = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if not r then break end
local vel = r.AssemblyLinearVelocity
vel = _V3new(0, vel.Y, 0)
r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vel * 10000 + _V3new(0, 10000, 0)
RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
if r and r.Parent then r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vel end
RunService.Stepped:Wait()
if r and r.Parent then r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vel + _V3new(0, 0.1, 0) end
end
finishDrop(flingThread)
end)
table.insert(dropConnections, flingThread)
task.delay(0.35, function()
if dropActive then finishDrop(flingThread) end
end)
return
end
dropActive = true
if dropBrainrotSetVisual then dropBrainrotSetVisual(true) end
if mobSetDropBR then mobSetDropBR(true) end
local t0 = _tick()
if _dropConn then _dropConn:Disconnect() end
_dropConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
local c = LP.Character
local r = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if not r then
if _dropConn then _dropConn:Disconnect(); _dropConn = nil end
dropActive = false
if dropBrainrotSetVisual then dropBrainrotSetVisual(false) end
if mobSetDropBR then mobSetDropBR(false) end
return
end
if not dropActive then
if _dropConn then _dropConn:Disconnect(); _dropConn = nil end
if dropBrainrotSetVisual then dropBrainrotSetVisual(false) end
if mobSetDropBR then mobSetDropBR(false) end
return
end
if _tick() - t0 >= DROP_ASCEND_DURATION then
if _dropConn then _dropConn:Disconnect(); _dropConn = nil end
pcall(function()
local rp = RaycastParams.new()
rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {c}
rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
local rr = workspace:Raycast(r.Position, _V3new(0, -3000, 0), rp)
if rr then
local hum2 = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local off = ((hum2 and hum2.HipHeight) or 2) + (r.Size.Y / 2)
r.CFrame = _CFnew(r.Position.X, rr.Position.Y + off, r.Position.Z)
r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = _V3zero
r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = _V3zero
end
if hum2 and hum2.Health > 0 then hum2:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end
end)
dropActive = false
if dropBrainrotSetVisual then dropBrainrotSetVisual(false) end
if mobSetDropBR then mobSetDropBR(false) end
return
end
local lv = r.AssemblyLinearVelocity
r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = _V3new(lv.X, DROP_ASCEND_SPEED, lv.Z)
end)
end
function executeDropWithToggle(setVisual)
if dropActive then return end
task.spawn(function()
if setVisual then setVisual(true) end
runDropBrainrot()
while dropActive do task.wait() end
task.wait(0.1)
if setVisual then setVisual(false) end
end)
end
function applyAntiLagDerender(obj)
pcall(function()
if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
obj.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
obj.Reflectance = 0
obj.CastShadow = false
elseif obj:IsA("Decal") or obj:IsA("Texture") then obj.Transparency = 1
elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or obj:IsA("Trail") or obj:IsA("Beam") or obj:IsA("Fire") or obj:IsA("Smoke") or obj:IsA("Sparkles") then
obj.Enabled = false
elseif obj:IsA("AnimationController") or obj:IsA("Animator") then
for _, t in ipairs(obj:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do pcall(function() t:Stop(0) end) end
end
end)
end
function enableAntiLag()
antiLagEnabled = true
task.spawn(function()
local descs = workspace:GetDescendants()
local i = 0
local total = #descs
while i < total and antiLagEnabled do
for _ = 1, 200 do
i = i + 1
if i > total then break end
applyAntiLagDerender(descs[i])
end
task.wait()
end
end)
if antiLagDescConn then antiLagDescConn:Disconnect() end
antiLagDescConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
if antiLagEnabled then applyAntiLagDerender(obj) end
end)
end
function disableAntiLag()
antiLagEnabled = false
if antiLagDescConn then antiLagDescConn:Disconnect(); antiLagDescConn = nil end
end
CUSTOM_FOV_BIND = "dowmvsCustomFOV"
function enableCustomFov()
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
if cam and origFOV == nil then origFOV = cam.FieldOfView end
fovEnabled = true
if cam then
pcall(function() cam.FieldOfViewMode = Enum.FieldOfViewMode.Diagonal end)
pcall(function() cam.FieldOfView = fovValue end)
end
if customFovConn then customFovConn:Disconnect(); customFovConn = nil end
pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(CUSTOM_FOV_BIND) end)
local prio = 200
pcall(function() prio = Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 10 end)
local ok = pcall(function()
RunService:BindToRenderStep(CUSTOM_FOV_BIND, prio, function()
if not fovEnabled then return end
local c = workspace.CurrentCamera
if c and c.FieldOfView ~= fovValue then
c.FieldOfView = fovValue
end
end)
end)
if not ok then
customFovConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
if not fovEnabled then
if customFovConn then customFovConn:Disconnect(); customFovConn = nil end
return
end
local c = workspace.CurrentCamera
if c then c.FieldOfView = fovValue end
end)
end
end
function disableCustomFov()
fovEnabled = false
pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(CUSTOM_FOV_BIND) end)
if customFovConn then customFovConn:Disconnect(); customFovConn = nil end
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
if cam then
pcall(function() cam.FieldOfViewMode = Enum.FieldOfViewMode.Vertical end)
pcall(function() cam.FieldOfView = origFOV or 70 end)
end
end
function applyStretchFOV(val)
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
if cam then pcall(function() cam.FieldOfView = val end) end
end
function enableStretch()
if stretchConn then return end
stretchEnabled = true
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
if not cam then return end
origFOV = cam.FieldOfView or 70
applyStretchFOV(stretchFOV)
stretchConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
if not stretchEnabled then
stretchConn:Disconnect()
stretchConn = nil
return
end
local c = workspace.CurrentCamera
if c then c.CFrame = c.CFrame * _CFnew(0,0,0,1,0,0,0,0.7,0,0,0,1) end
end)
if stretchFovConn then stretchFovConn:Disconnect() end
stretchFovConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
if stretchEnabled then applyStretchFOV(stretchFOV)
else stretchFovConn:Disconnect(); stretchFovConn = nil end
end)
end
function disableStretch()
stretchEnabled = false
if stretchConn then stretchConn:Disconnect(); stretchConn = nil end
if stretchFovConn then stretchFovConn:Disconnect(); stretchFovConn = nil end
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
if cam then pcall(function() cam.FieldOfView = origFOV or 70 end) end
end
local function saveLightingState()
if _originalLighting then return end
_originalLighting = {
Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime,
OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
FogStart = Lighting.FogStart,
FogColor = Lighting.FogColor,
Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
ColorCorrection = nil,
Bloom = nil,
}
for _, e in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
if e:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then
_originalLighting.ColorCorrection = {
Enabled = e.Enabled,
Brightness = e.Brightness,
Contrast = e.Contrast,
Saturation = e.Saturation,
TintColor = e.TintColor,
}
elseif e:IsA("BloomEffect") then
_originalLighting.Bloom = {
Enabled = e.Enabled,
Intensity = e.Intensity,
Size = e.Size,
Threshold = e.Threshold,
}
end
end
end
local function restoreLightingState()
if not _originalLighting then return end
local old = _originalLighting
Lighting.Brightness = old.Brightness
Lighting.ClockTime = old.ClockTime
Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = old.OutdoorAmbient
Lighting.GlobalShadows = old.GlobalShadows
Lighting.FogEnd = old.FogEnd
Lighting.FogStart = old.FogStart
Lighting.FogColor = old.FogColor
Lighting.Ambient = old.Ambient
if old.ColorCorrection then
local cc = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("ColorCorrectionEffect")
if cc then
cc.Enabled = old.ColorCorrection.Enabled
cc.Brightness = old.ColorCorrection.Brightness
cc.Contrast = old.ColorCorrection.Contrast
cc.Saturation = old.ColorCorrection.Saturation
cc.TintColor = old.ColorCorrection.TintColor
end
end
if old.Bloom then
local bloom = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("BloomEffect")
if bloom then
bloom.Enabled = old.Bloom.Enabled
bloom.Intensity = old.Bloom.Intensity
bloom.Size = old.Bloom.Size
bloom.Threshold = old.Bloom.Threshold
end
end
end

local function _vC3(t) return Color3.fromRGB(t[1], t[2], t[3]) end
function _v4mpClearSky()
for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
if child:GetAttribute("_AdaptDuelsSky") then
pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
end
end
local terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
if terrain then
for _, child in ipairs(terrain:GetChildren()) do
if child:GetAttribute("_AdaptDuelsSky") then
pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
end
end
end
end
function applyCustomSky(mode)
_v4mpClearSky()
local preset = SKY_PRESETS[mode]
if not preset or preset.kind == "off" then
Lighting.ClockTime = 14
Lighting.Brightness = 2
Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(127,127,127)
Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(127,127,127)
Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
skyTheme = "Off"
return
end
Lighting.FogStart = 0
Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
Lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(200,200,200)
Lighting.ColorShift_Top = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
Lighting.ColorShift_Bottom = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
Lighting.ClockTime = preset.clock or 14
Lighting.Brightness = preset.brightness or 2
if preset.outAmb then Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = _vC3(preset.outAmb) end
if preset.ambient then Lighting.Ambient = _vC3(preset.ambient) end
if preset.sky then
local skyInst = Instance.new("Sky")
skyInst:SetAttribute("_AdaptDuelsSky", true)
if preset.sky.stars then skyInst.StarCount = preset.sky.stars end
if preset.sky.moon then skyInst.MoonAngularSize = preset.sky.moon end
if preset.sky.sun then skyInst.SunAngularSize = preset.sky.sun end
if preset.sky.moonTex then skyInst.MoonTextureId = "rbxasset://sky/moon.jpg" end
skyInst.Parent = Lighting
end
if preset.atm then
local atm = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
atm:SetAttribute("_AdaptDuelsSky", true)
atm.Density = preset.atm.dens or 0.3
atm.Color = _vC3(preset.atm.color)
atm.Decay = _vC3(preset.atm.decay)
atm.Glare = preset.atm.glare or 1
atm.Haze = preset.atm.haze or 1
atm.Parent = Lighting
end
local terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
if preset.clouds and terrain then
local clouds = Instance.new("Clouds")
clouds:SetAttribute("_AdaptDuelsSky", true)
clouds.Cover = preset.clouds.cover or 0.5
clouds.Density = preset.clouds.dens or 0.5
clouds.Color = _vC3(preset.clouds.color)
clouds.Parent = terrain
end
skyTheme = mode
end
local function applyNeonWeather()
if not neonWeatherEnabled then
restoreLightingState()
return
end
if not _originalLighting then saveLightingState() end
Lighting.Brightness = 3.5
Lighting.ClockTime = 20
Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(80, 20, 20)
Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
Lighting.FogEnd = 300
Lighting.FogStart = 0
Lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(200, 0, 0)
Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(120, 30, 30)
local cc = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("ColorCorrectionEffect")
if not cc then
cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
cc.Parent = Lighting
end
cc.Enabled = true
cc.Brightness = 0.2
cc.Contrast = 0.15
cc.Saturation = 0.15
cc.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 200)
local bloom = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("BloomEffect")
if not bloom then
bloom = Instance.new("BloomEffect")
bloom.Parent = Lighting
end
bloom.Enabled = true
bloom.Intensity = 0.6
bloom.Size = 25
bloom.Threshold = 0.8
end
function toggleNeonWeather(state)
if state == nil then
neonWeatherEnabled = not neonWeatherEnabled
else
neonWeatherEnabled = state
end
applyNeonWeather()
if setNeonWeatherVisual then setNeonWeatherVisual(neonWeatherEnabled) end
end
function paintFloatingBtn(btnFrame, active)
if not btnFrame then return end
local bg = btnFrame:FindFirstChild("BtnGrad")
local label = btnFrame:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
local stroke = btnFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
local c = getThemeColor and getThemeColor() or Color3.fromRGB(90, 180, 255)
-- Sky panel palette
local skyTop = Color3.fromRGB(55, 140, 230)
local skyMid = Color3.fromRGB(30, 90, 170)
local skyBot = Color3.fromRGB(15, 50, 110)
if active then
btnFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 120, 210)
if bg then
bg.Enabled = true
bg.Rotation = 125
bg.Color = ColorSequence.new({
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, c:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1), 0.45)),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, c),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, c:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(10,40,90), 0.4)),
})
end
if label then
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.55
end
if stroke then
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(160, 220, 255)
stroke.Thickness = 1.5
stroke.Transparency = 0.1
end
else
btnFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 55, 105)
if bg then
bg.Enabled = true
bg.Rotation = 125
bg.Color = ColorSequence.new({
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, skyTop),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.50, skyMid),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, skyBot),
})
end
if label then
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 240, 255)
label.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
end
if stroke then
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 180, 255)
stroke.Thickness = 1.2
stroke.Transparency = 0.25
end
end
end

function applyFloatingButtonScale()
for _, uiScale in ipairs(_floatingUIScales) do
if uiScale and uiScale.Parent then
uiScale.Scale = floatingButtonScale
end
end
end
local function drag(f)
-- Reliable drag for Frame/TextButton (mouse + touch/mobile)
local dn, ds, sp = false, nil, nil
local function stopDrag()
dn = false
ds = nil
sp = nil
end
local function beginDrag(i)
if uiLocked then return end
if _isDraggingButton then return end
if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dn = true
ds = i.Position
sp = f.Position
end
end
local function moveDrag(i)
if not dn or not ds or not sp then return end
if uiLocked then stopDrag(); return end
if _isDraggingButton then return end
if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
local nX = sp.X.Offset + (i.Position.X - ds.X)
local nY = sp.Y.Offset + (i.Position.Y - ds.Y)
f.Position = UDim2.new(sp.X.Scale, nX, sp.Y.Scale, nY)
end
f.Active = true
if f:IsA("GuiObject") then
pcall(function() f.Selectable = true end)
end
f.InputBegan:Connect(beginDrag)
f.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
stopDrag()
end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(moveDrag)
UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
stopDrag()
end
end)
end
function setupMovementAndIndicators(char)
local carryHumanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if carryHumanoid then
CarrySystem._walkSpeedHumanoid = carryHumanoid
CarrySystem._normalWalkSpeed = carryHumanoid.WalkSpeed
CarrySystem._isCarrying = false
CarrySystem._lastCarryCheck = 0
end
if steppedConn then steppedConn:Disconnect(); steppedConn = nil end
if movementLoop then movementLoop:Disconnect(); movementLoop = nil end
local ccAcc = 0
steppedConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
ccAcc = ccAcc + dt
if ccAcc < 0.20 then return end
ccAcc = 0
local plist = _GetPlayersCached()
for i = 1, #plist do
local p = plist[i]
if p ~= LP then
local ch = p.Character
if ch then
local parts = ch:GetChildren()
for j = 1, #parts do
local part = parts[j]
if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then
part.CanCollide = false
end
end
end
end
end
end)
movementLoop = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
local char2 = LP.Character
if not char2 then return end
local hum = char2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local hrp = char2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if not hum or not hrp then return end
-- Auto Left/Right: re-apply velocity every frame so physics/CarrySystem doesn't cancel it
if (autoLeftEnabled or autoRightEnabled) and not _isRagdollState(hum) then
local phase = autoLeftEnabled and alPhase or arPhase
local pt
if autoLeftEnabled then
pt = (phase == 1) and AP.L1 or AP.L2
else
pt = (phase == 1) and AP.R1 or AP.R2
end
local d = _V3new(pt.X - hrp.Position.X, 0, pt.Z - hrp.Position.Z)
if d.Magnitude > 0.05 then
local mv = d.Unit
local spd = getAutoPathSpeed and getAutoPathSpeed() or NS
hum:Move(mv, false)
_applyVelocitySpeed(mv, spd, hrp)
if CarrySystem and CarrySystem._lvBoost and CarrySystem._lvBoost.Parent == hrp then
CarrySystem._lvBoost.PlaneVelocity = Vector2.new(mv.X * spd, mv.Z * spd)
end
end
elseif not autoBatEnabled and not autoBatBypassEnabled then
if _isRagdollState(hum) then
lastMoveDir = _V3zero
else
local md = hum.MoveDirection
local spd = getActiveMoveSpeed()
local dir = nil
if md.Magnitude > 0 then
lastMoveDir = md
dir = md
elseif lastMoveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
for key in pairs(MOVE_KEYS) do
if UIS:IsKeyDown(key) then dir = lastMoveDir; break end
end
end
_applyVelocitySpeed(dir, spd, hrp)
end
end
if speedLabel then
local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
local s = _sqrt(v.X*v.X + v.Z*v.Z)
if s < 0.05 then s = 0 end
speedLabel.Text = "Speed: " .. string.format("%.1f", s)
end
end)
setupSpeedIndicator(char)
startEnemySpeed()
end
function toggleLockUI(state)
if state == nil then uiLocked = not uiLocked else uiLocked = state end
if uiLocked and editModeEnabled then
editModeEnabled = false
if setEditModeVisual then setEditModeVisual(false) end
end
if setLockUIVisual then setLockUIVisual(uiLocked) end
end
function toggleEditMode(state)
if state == nil then state = not editModeEnabled end
if state and uiLocked then state = false end
editModeEnabled = state
if setEditModeVisual then setEditModeVisual(editModeEnabled) end
end
function disableAllAimbots()
if autoBatEnabled then
disableAutoBat()
if autoBatSetVisual then autoBatSetVisual(false) end
if mobSetAutoBat then mobSetAutoBat(false) end
end
if autoBatBypassEnabled then
disableBatBypass()
if autoBatBypassSetVisual then autoBatBypassSetVisual(false) end
if batBypassFloatingButton then
local btnFrame = batBypassFloatingButton:FindFirstChild("Frame")
if btnFrame then paintFloatingBtn(btnFrame, false) end
end
end
if autoBatV3Enabled then
disableBatV3()
end
end
function stopConfuser()
confuserEnabled = false
if confuserConn then pcall(function() confuserConn:Disconnect() end); confuserConn = nil end
local char = LP.Character
local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hum then hum.AutoRotate = (confuserPrevAutoRotate == nil) and true or confuserPrevAutoRotate end
confuserPrevAutoRotate = nil
if confuserStartedAntiDie and not antiDieEnabled then pcall(AntiDieModule.stop) end
confuserStartedAntiDie = false
end
function startConfuser()
if confuserConn then return end
confuserEnabled = true
local hum = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hum then confuserPrevAutoRotate = hum.AutoRotate; hum.AutoRotate = false end
if not AntiDieModule.enabled then confuserStartedAntiDie = true; pcall(AntiDieModule.start) end
confuserConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
if not confuserEnabled then return end
local char = LP.Character
local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if not root then return end
local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hum then hum.AutoRotate = false end
local step = math.max(0, tonumber(confuserSpeed) or 50) * dt * 60
root.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(step), 0)
root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end)
end
function setConfuserEnabled(on)
if on then startConfuser() else stopConfuser() end
end

function stopAllBackgroundTasks()
if movementLoop then movementLoop:Disconnect(); movementLoop = nil end
if steppedConn then steppedConn:Disconnect(); steppedConn = nil end
stopEnemySpeed()
if stretchEnabled then disableStretch() end
if stretchConn then stretchConn:Disconnect(); stretchConn = nil end
if stretchFovConn then stretchFovConn:Disconnect(); stretchFovConn = nil end
if AntiRagdollV1.isRunning() then AntiRagdollV1.stop() end
if AntiRagdollV2.Enabled then stopAntiRagdollV2() end
if antiDieEnabled then AntiDieModule.stop() end
if antiFlingEnabled then AntiFlingShieldModule.stop() end
stopBatCounter()
stopBatCounterBypass()
stopMedusaCounter()
stopAutoSteal()
disableAutoBat()
if autoBatBypassEnabled then disableBatBypass() end
if autoBatV3Enabled then disableBatV3() end
stopAutoLeft()
stopAutoRight()
if unwalkEnabled then stopUnwalk() end
if antiLagEnabled then disableAntiLag() end
if espEnabled then toggleESP(false) end
if dropActive then stopDropBrainrot() end
if bodyLockEnabled then stopBodyLock() end
_blSuppressCount = 0
_blWasEnabled = false
if _blRestoreTimer then
pcall(task.cancel, _blRestoreTimer)
_blRestoreTimer = nil
end
if _bodyLockConn then
_bodyLockConn:Disconnect()
_bodyLockConn = nil
end
for _, t in ipairs(dropConnections) do
if type(t) == "thread" then pcall(task.cancel, t)
elseif type(t) == "RBXScriptConnection" then pcall(t.Disconnect, t) end
end
dropConnections = {}
dropActive = false
alPhase = 1
arPhase = 1
lastDropTime = 0
medusaDebounce = false
medusaLastUsed = 0
end

floatingButtonScale = floatingButtonScale,

batSkinId = DowmSkins and DowmSkins.batId or nil,
medusaSkinId = DowmSkins and DowmSkins.medusaId or nil,
themeColor = currentColorTheme,
useCarrySystem = useCarrySystem,
autoCarrySpeed = CarrySystem.autoCarrySpeedEnabled,
carrySysNormal = CarrySystem.normalSpeed,

carrySysLaggerCarry = CarrySystem.laggerCarrySpeed,
noLagCap = NOLAG_CAP,

}

-- ==================== COMPLETE AUTO-SAVE SYSTEM ====================
_saveFS = _saveFS or {}
do
local function pick(...)
for i = 1, select("#", ...) do
local f = select(i, ...)
if type(f) == "function" then return f end
end
end
local synT = type(syn) == "table" and syn or nil
_saveFS.write = pick(
writefile,
synT and synT.writefile,
(getgenv and getgenv().writefile)
)
_saveFS.read = pick(
readfile,
synT and synT.readfile,
(getgenv and getgenv().readfile)
)
_saveFS.isfile = pick(
isfile,
synT and synT.isfile,
(getgenv and getgenv().isfile)
)
_saveFS.delfile = pick(
delfile,
synT and synT.delfile,
(getgenv and getgenv().delfile)
)
end

_lastSavedJSON = _lastSavedJSON or nil
_saveDirty = false
_saveInFlight = false
_saveQueued = false
_lastSaveOk = true
_lastSaveAt = 0
_saveFailStreak = 0

local function _saveResolvePath()
local uid = (LP and LP.UserId) and tostring(LP.UserId) or "0"
return {
CONFIG_FILE,
"BloodHounds_" .. uid .. ".json",
"BloodHounds_settings.json",
}
end

function saveAllSettings(force)
if _isResetting or _isLoading then
_saveDirty = true
return false
end
if type(HS) ~= "table" and typeof(HS) ~= "Instance" then return false end
local okBuild, config = pcall(buildConfigTable)
if not okBuild or type(config) ~= "table" then return false end
local okJson, json = pcall(function() return HS:JSONEncode(config) end)
if not okJson or type(json) ~= "string" then return false end
if not force and json == _lastSavedJSON then
_saveDirty = false
return true
end
if type(_saveFS.write) ~= "function" then
_saveFailStreak = _saveFailStreak + 1
return false
end
if _saveInFlight then
_saveQueued = true
_saveDirty = true
return false
end
_saveInFlight = true
local success = false
for _, path in ipairs(_saveResolvePath()) do
local ok = pcall(_saveFS.write, path, json)
if ok then
success = true
CONFIG_FILE = path
break
end
end
_saveInFlight = false
if success then
_lastSavedJSON = json
_saveDirty = false
_lastSaveOk = true
_lastSaveAt = tick()
_saveFailStreak = 0
else
_saveDirty = true
_lastSaveOk = false
_saveFailStreak = _saveFailStreak + 1
end
if _saveQueued then
_saveQueued = false
task.defer(function() saveAllSettings(true) end)
end
return success
end

function markSettingsDirty()
_saveDirty = true
end

function forceSaveSettings()
return saveAllSettings(true)
end

-- Debounced autosave: coalesces bursts, retries on fail
task.spawn(function()
while true do
task.wait(1.25)
if _saveDirty and not _isLoading and not _isResetting then
pcall(function() saveAllSettings(true) end)
end
end
end)

-- Heartbeat backup every 8s
task.spawn(function()
while true do
task.wait(8)
if not _isLoading and not _isResetting then
pcall(function() saveAllSettings(false) end)
end
end
end)

-- Flush on leave
pcall(function()
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
if plr == LP then pcall(function() saveAllSettings(true) end) end
end)
end)
pcall(function()
game:BindToClose(function()
pcall(function() saveAllSettings(true) end)
end)
end)

function loadAllSettings()
local raw
local paths = _saveResolvePath and _saveResolvePath() or {CONFIG_FILE}
for _, path in ipairs(paths) do
local exists = false
if type(_saveFS.isfile) == "function" then
local okE, res = pcall(_saveFS.isfile, path)
exists = okE and res == true
elseif type(isfile) == "function" then
local okE, res = pcall(isfile, path)
exists = okE and res == true
end
if exists and type(_saveFS.read or readfile) == "function" then
local okR, body = pcall(_saveFS.read or readfile, path)
if okR and type(body) == "string" and #body > 2 then
raw = body
CONFIG_FILE = path
break
end
end
end
if not raw then return false end
local success, data = pcall(function() return HS:JSONDecode(raw) end)
if not success or type(data) ~= "table" then return false end
_isLoading = true
NS = data.normalSpeed or NS
CS = (data.carrySpeed == 29 and 35) or data.carrySpeed or CS
LAGGER_SPEED = data.laggerSpeed1 or LAGGER_SPEED
LAGGER_CARRY_SPEED = data.laggerSpeed2 or LAGGER_CARRY_SPEED
CONFIG.STEAL_RANGE = data.stealRadius or CONFIG.STEAL_RANGE
if radInput then radInput.Text = tostring(CONFIG.STEAL_RANGE) end
if data.lockUI ~= nil then uiLocked = data.lockUI else uiLocked = false end
editModeEnabled = data.editMode or false
if data.antiRagdollMode then
antiRagdollMode = data.antiRagdollMode
else
antiRagdollMode = data.antiRagdoll and "v2" or "off"
end
antiDieEnabled = data.antiDieEnabled or false
antiBatEnabled = data.antiBatEnabled == true
confuserSpeed = tonumber(data.confuserSpeed) or 50
confuserActiveOnSteal = data.confuserActiveOnSteal == true

antiFlingEnabled = data.antiFlingEnabled or false
hideButtonsEnabled = data.hideButtons == true
CONFIG.AUTO_STEAL_ENABLED = data.autoSteal or false
medusaCounterEnabled = data.medusaCounter or false
batCounterEnabled = data.batCounter or false
batCounterBypassEnabled = data.batCounterBypass == true
unwalkEnabled = data.unwalk or false
antiLagEnabled = data.antiLag or false
cursorRgbEnabled = data.cursorRgb == true
-- restore happens in updateUIFromLoaded after GUI exists

laggerToggled = data.laggerToggled or false
speedMode = data.carryMode or false
laggerCarryToggled = data.laggerCarryToggled or false
uiScaleValue = tonumber(data.uiScale) or 85
if mainUIScale then mainUIScale.Scale = uiScaleValue / 100 end
if pbScale then pbScale.Scale = uiScaleValue / 100 end
espEnabled = data.espEnabled or false
if espEnabled then toggleESP(true) else toggleESP(false) end
if data.themeColor and COLOR_THEMES[data.themeColor] then
currentColorTheme = data.themeColor
selectedColor = COLOR_THEMES[data.themeColor]
task.defer(function()
updateAllUIThemeColors(selectedColor)
if colorSelectorLabel then
colorSelectorLabel.Text = currentColorTheme
colorSelectorLabel.TextColor3 = selectedColor
end
end)
end
autoBatBypassEnabled = data.autoBatBypassEnabled or false
batBypassVersion = (data.batBypassVersion == 3) and 3 or ((data.batBypassVersion == 2) and 2 or 1)
if data.batV3Distance then _batV3Distance = tonumber(data.batV3Distance) or _batV3Distance end
if data.batV3FloatingPos then batV3FloatingPos = data.batV3FloatingPos end
if data.autoBatV3Enabled then
-- restore after UI via updateUIFromLoaded / deferred
_pendingAuto = _pendingAuto or {}
_pendingAuto.batV3 = true
end
if data.mainGuiPos and main then
pcall(function()
main.Position = UDim2.new(
data.mainGuiPos.XScale or 0,
data.mainGuiPos.XOffset or 20,
data.mainGuiPos.YScale or 0,
data.mainGuiPos.YOffset or 2
)
end)
end

if autoBatBypassEnabled then
task.defer(function()
enableBatBypass()
if autoBatBypassSetVisual then autoBatBypassSetVisual(true) end
end)
else
if autoBatBypassSetVisual then autoBatBypassSetVisual(false) end
end
skyTheme = data.skyTheme or "Off"
if skyTheme ~= "Off" then pcall(applyCustomSky, skyTheme) end
if skySelectorLabel then skySelectorLabel.Text = skyTheme end
neonWeatherEnabled = data.neonWeather or false
if neonWeatherEnabled then
task.defer(function() toggleNeonWeather(true) end)
else
toggleNeonWeather(false)
skyTheme = "Off"
pcall(applyCustomSky, "Off")
if skySelectorLabel then skySelectorLabel.Text = "Off" end
end
if data.animPack and ANIM_PACKS[data.animPack] then
startAnimPack(data.animPack)
else
currentAnimPack = "Off"
stopAnimPack()
end
local function lk(e, d)
if not d then return end
if d.kb and Enum.KeyCode[d.kb] then e.kb = Enum.KeyCode[d.kb] end
if d.gp and Enum.KeyCode[d.gp] then e.gp = Enum.KeyCode[d.gp] end
end
lk(KB.DropBrainrot, data.dropBrainrotKey)
lk(KB.AutoLeft, data.autoLeftKey)
lk(KB.AutoRight, data.autoRightKey)
lk(KB.AutoBat, data.autoBatKey)
lk(KB.TPReset, data.tpFloorKey)
lk(KB.CarryToggle, data.carryToggleKey)
lk(KB.LaggerMode, data.laggerModeKey)
lk(KB.BatBypass, data.batBypassKey)
lk(KB.PingLagger, data.pingLaggerKey)
if PingLagger then
PingLagger.cfg.power = tonumber(data.pingLaggerPower) or PingLagger.defaults.power
PingLagger.cfg.interval = math.max(tonumber(data.pingLaggerInterval) or PingLagger.defaults.interval, 0.01)
if type(data.pingLaggerAuto) == "boolean" then PingLagger.cfg.autoBrainrot = data.pingLaggerAuto else PingLagger.cfg.autoBrainrot = PingLagger.defaults.autoBrainrot end
end
lk(KB.InstaReset, data.instaResetKey)
if data.mobileButtonPositions then savedButtonPositions = data.mobileButtonPositions end
if data.mobilePanelPos then savedMobilePanelPos = data.mobilePanelPos end
if data.batBypassFloatingPos then batBypassFloatingPos = data.batBypassFloatingPos end
if data.instaResetFloatingPos then instaResetFloatingPos = data.instaResetFloatingPos end
if data.progressBarPos then savedProgressBarPos = data.progressBarPos end
if data.bodyLockEnabled ~= nil then
bodyLockEnabled = data.bodyLockEnabled
if bodyLockEnabled then
task.defer(function()
if bodyLockSetVisual then bodyLockSetVisual(true) end
startBodyLock()
end)
end
end
if data.bodyLockRange then
bodyLockRange = data.bodyLockRange
if bodyLockRangeBox then bodyLockRangeBox.Text = tostring(bodyLockRange) end
end
dropMode = data.dropMode or 1
stretchEnabled = data.stretchEnabled or false
fovValue = data.fovValue or 70
fovEnabled = data.fovEnabled or false
if fovSliderSet then fovSliderSet(fovValue) end
if fovEnabled then enableCustomFov() end
if setFovVisual then setFovVisual(fovEnabled) end
stretchFOV = data.stretchFOV or 120
BAT_AIMBOT_SPEED = data.batAimbotSpeed or BAT_AIMBOT_SPEED
batV1Bypass = true
backgroundIndex = tonumber(data.backgroundIndex) or backgroundIndex
backgroundImageTransparency = data.backgroundImageTransparency or 0
floatingButtonScale = data.floatingButtonScale or 1
if data.outfitIndex and data.outfitIndex >= 1 and data.outfitIndex <= #OUTFITS then
currentOutfitIndex = data.outfitIndex
task.defer(function()
pcall(function() applyOutfitByIndex(currentOutfitIndex) end)

end
end)
end
if DowmSkins then

DowmSkins.medusaId = data.medusaSkinId
end
useCarrySystem = data.useCarrySystem or false
CarrySystem.autoCarrySpeedEnabled = data.autoCarrySpeed == true
if CarrySystem.autoCarrySpeedEnabled then
	CarrySystem:startSoftStealScanner()
end
CarrySystem.normalSpeed = data.carrySysNormal or NS
CarrySystem.carrySpeed = (data.carrySysCarry == 29 and 35) or data.carrySysCarry or CS
CarrySystem.laggerSpeed = data.carrySysLagger or LAGGER_SPEED
CarrySystem.laggerCarrySpeed = data.carrySysLaggerCarry or LAGGER_CARRY_SPEED
NOLAG_CAP = math.clamp((data.noLagCap == 29 and 35) or tonumber(data.noLagCap) or NOLAG_CAP, 1, 1000)
if useCarrySystem then
CarrySystem:start()
CarrySystem.speedToggled = speedMode
if laggerToggled then
else
CarrySystem:setLaggerMode(0)
end
else
CarrySystem:stop()
end
_pendingAuto = {bat = data.autoBat == true, left = data.autoLeft == true, right = data.autoRight == true}
autoBatEnabled = false
autoLeftEnabled = false
autoRightEnabled = false
if dropModeBtnRef then dropModeBtnRef.Text = dropMode == 1 and "Fling" or "Jump Drop" end
refreshSpeedModeLabel()
_lastSavedJSON = HS:JSONEncode(buildConfigTable())
_isLoading = false
return true
end

function applyShimmerToText(obj, speed)

local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient", obj)
grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({

function getDefaultButtonPosition(btnName)
local BTN_W, BTN_H = 60, 60
local GAP = 8
local orderMap = {
DropBR = 0, AutoLeft = 1, AutoBat = 2, AutoRight = 3,
TpReset = 4, Carry = 5, Lagger1 = 6, Lagger2 = 7
}
local order = orderMap[btnName] or 0
local row = _floor(order / 2)
local col = order % 2
return col * (BTN_W + GAP), row * (BTN_H + GAP + 10)
end
do
print("[IR] 1. inicio")
if _G.InstaResetLoaded then
print("[IR] ya cargado")
else
_G.InstaResetLoaded = true
local resetCooldown          = false
local resetThread            = nil
local currentResetChar       = nil
local resetSuccessful        = false
local stopResetSequence      = false
local cameraLocked           = false
local lockedCameraCFrame     = nil
local _lastInstaResetRequest = 0
print("[IR] 2. servicios OK, LP =", LP and LP.Name)
local function instaResetFast()
if resetCooldown then return end
resetCooldown     = true
resetSuccessful   = false
stopResetSequence = false
cameraLocked      = false
local character = LP.Character
if not character then resetCooldown = false return end
local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not humanoid then resetCooldown = false return end
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
if cam then
lockedCameraCFrame = cam.CFrame
cameraLocked       = true
cam.CFrame         = lockedCameraCFrame
end
currentResetChar = character
local isRespawning = false
resetThread = task.spawn(function()
local attempts          = 0
local maxAttempts       = 40
local originalHipHeight = humanoid.HipHeight
while character and character.Parent and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0
and not isRespawning and not stopResetSequence do
if LP.Character ~= character then
isRespawning = true
break
end
pcall(function()
humanoid.HipHeight  = 1e30
humanoid.AutoRotate = true
local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if rootPart then rootPart.CanCollide = false end
for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
part.CanCollide = false
end
end
end)
if not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid
or humanoid.Health <= 0 or LP.Character ~= character then
resetSuccessful = true
break
end
attempts = attempts + 1
if attempts >= maxAttempts then break end
task.wait(0.05)
end
if not resetSuccessful then
if character and character.Parent and humanoid
and humanoid.Health > 0 and not isRespawning then
pcall(function() humanoid.Health = 0 end)
task.wait(0.1)
if not character.Parent or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
resetSuccessful = true
end
end
end
if not resetSuccessful and character and character.Parent and humanoid then
pcall(function()
humanoid.HipHeight = originalHipHeight
local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if rootPart then rootPart.CanCollide = true end
for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
part.CanCollide = true
end
end
end)
end
cameraLocked      = false
resetCooldown     = false
resetThread       = nil
currentResetChar  = nil
stopResetSequence = false
end)
end
local function instaReset()
local now = os.clock()
if now - _lastInstaResetRequest < 0.75 then return end
_lastInstaResetRequest = now
instaResetFast()
end
print("[IR] 3. función lista")
LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
stopResetSequence = true
if resetThread then pcall(task.cancel, resetThread); resetThread = nil end
resetCooldown    = false
currentResetChar = nil
cameraLocked     = false
end)
task.spawn(function()
while true do
task.wait(0.05)
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
if cameraLocked and lockedCameraCFrame and cam then
cam.CFrame = lockedCameraCFrame
end
end
end)
print("[IR] 4. loop cámara iniciado")
_G.InstaReset = { Trigger = instaReset }
end
end
SKIN_MEDUSA = {
{id = 11563251, name = "Medusa 1"},
}
SKIN_BAT = {
{id = 14052995337, name = "Epic Katana", soundId = "rbxassetid://111808555599832", c0 = CFrame.new()},
{id = 126653333198410, name = "Bloody Katana", soundId = "rbxassetid://111808555599832", c0 = CFrame.new()},
}
DowmSkins = { batId = nil, medusaId = nil }
do
local InsertService = game:GetService("InsertService")
local SKIN_BAT_BY_ID = {}
for _, skin in ipairs(SKIN_BAT) do SKIN_BAT_BY_ID[tostring(skin.id)] = skin end
local soundConns = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local function getBatSkinConfig(assetId)
return SKIN_BAT_BY_ID[tostring(tonumber(tostring(assetId):match("%d+")) or assetId)]
end
local function setBatSkinSound(tool, assetId)
if not tool then return end
local config = assetId and getBatSkinConfig(assetId) or nil
local desired = config and config.soundId or nil
tool:SetAttribute("DowmCurrentBatSkinId", desired and tostring(config.id) or nil)
for _, sound in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
if sound:IsA("Sound") and sound.Name == "Slash" then
local original = sound:GetAttribute("DowmOriginalSlashSound")
if desired then
if original == nil then sound:SetAttribute("DowmOriginalSlashSound", sound.SoundId) end
sound.SoundId = desired
elseif original ~= nil then
sound.SoundId = original
sound:SetAttribute("DowmOriginalSlashSound", nil)
end
end
end
if not soundConns[tool] then
soundConns[tool] = tool.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
if not object:IsA("Sound") or object.Name ~= "Slash" then return end
local activeId = tool:GetAttribute("DowmCurrentBatSkinId")
if activeId then task.defer(setBatSkinSound, tool, activeId) end
end)
end
end
local function loadAssetObjects(assetId)
assetId = tonumber(tostring(assetId):match("%d+"))
if not assetId then return nil end
local ok, res = pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(assetId)) end)
if ok and type(res) == "table" and #res > 0 then return res end
ok, res = pcall(function() return InsertService:LoadAsset(assetId) end)
if ok and res then
if res:IsA("Model") then
local children = res:GetChildren()
if #children > 0 then return children end
end
return { res }
end
return nil
end
local function getCharModel()
return workspace:FindFirstChild(LP.Name) or LP.Character
end
local function findTool(name)
local model = getCharModel()
if model then
local t = model:FindFirstChild(name)
if t then return t end
end
local bp = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
if bp then
local t = bp:FindFirstChild(name)
if t then return t end
end
return nil
end
local function clearGearVisual(tool)
if not tool then return end
pcall(function()
local folder = tool:FindFirstChild("DowmGearVisual")
if folder then folder:Destroy() end
local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") or tool:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
if handle then
for _, ch in ipairs(handle:GetChildren()) do
if ch.Name == "DowmGearMesh" or (ch:IsA("SpecialMesh") and ch:GetAttribute("DowmSkin")) then
ch:Destroy()
end
end
local orig = tool:GetAttribute("DowmOrigHandleTrans")
if orig ~= nil then
handle.Transparency = orig
elseif handle.Transparency >= 0.99 then
handle.Transparency = 0
end
end
end)
end
local function applyAssetToTool(tool, assetId)
if not tool or not assetId then return false end
if tool:GetAttribute("DowmApplying") then return false end
tool:SetAttribute("DowmApplying", true)
assetId = tonumber(tostring(assetId):match("%d+")) or assetId
local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") or tool:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
if not handle then
tool:SetAttribute("DowmApplying", nil)
return false
end
local success = false
pcall(function()
clearGearVisual(tool)
if tool:GetAttribute("DowmOrigHandleTrans") == nil then
tool:SetAttribute("DowmOrigHandleTrans", handle.Transparency)
end
local objs = loadAssetObjects(assetId)
if not objs or #objs == 0 then return end
local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = "DowmGearVisual"
folder.Parent = tool
local srcTool, srcHandle
for _, o in ipairs(objs) do
if o:IsA("Tool") then
srcTool = o
srcHandle = o:FindFirstChild("Handle") or o:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
break
end
local t = o:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or o:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool", true)
if t then
srcTool = t
srcHandle = t:FindFirstChild("Handle") or t:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
break
end
end
if not srcHandle then
for _, o in ipairs(objs) do
if o:IsA("BasePart") then srcHandle = o; break end
local p = o:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
if p then srcHandle = p; break end
end
end
local skinConfig = tool.Name == "Bat" and getBatSkinConfig(assetId) or nil
local orientFix = skinConfig and skinConfig.c0 or CFrame.new()
local parts = {}
local root = srcTool or objs[1]
if root then
if root:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(parts, root) end
if root:IsA("Accessory") then
local ah = root:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if ah then table.insert(parts, ah) end
end
for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
if d:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(parts, d) end
end
end
if #parts == 0 and srcHandle then table.insert(parts, srcHandle) end
local seen, unique = {}, {}
for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
if not seen[p] then seen[p] = true; table.insert(unique, p) end
end
parts = unique
if #parts > 0 then
handle.Transparency = 1
local pivot = srcHandle or parts[1]
for _, src in ipairs(parts) do
local okc, clone = pcall(function() return src:Clone() end)
if okc and clone then
clone.Name = "GV_" .. tostring(src.Name)
clone.Anchored = false
clone.CanCollide = false
clone.Massless = true
pcall(function()
clone.CanQuery = false
clone.CanTouch = false
end)
local rel = pivot.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(src.CFrame)
clone.CFrame = handle.CFrame * orientFix * rel
clone.Parent = folder
local w = Instance.new("Weld")
w.Name = "DowmGearWeld"
w.Part0 = handle
w.Part1 = clone
w.C0 = orientFix * rel
w.C1 = CFrame.new()
w.Parent = clone
success = true
end
end
elseif srcHandle then
local mesh = srcHandle:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
if mesh then
local m = mesh:Clone()
m.Name = "DowmGearMesh"
m:SetAttribute("DowmSkin", true)
m.Parent = handle
success = true
end
for _, d in ipairs(srcHandle:GetChildren()) do
if d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
pcall(function() d:Clone().Parent = handle end)
end
end
pcall(function()
handle.Color = srcHandle.Color
handle.Material = srcHandle.Material
handle.Reflectance = srcHandle.Reflectance
end)
end
for _, o in ipairs(objs) do pcall(function() o:Destroy() end) end
end)
tool:SetAttribute("DowmApplying", nil)
if success and tool.Name == "Bat" then setBatSkinSound(tool, assetId) end
return success
end
function DowmSkins.apply(category, id)
local tool = (category == "medusa") and findTool("Medusa's Head") or findTool("Bat")
if not tool then return false end
local ok = false
if id == nil then
clearGearVisual(tool)
if category == "bat" then setBatSkinSound(tool, nil) end
ok = true
else
ok = applyAssetToTool(tool, id) == true
end
if ok then
if category == "medusa" then DowmSkins.medusaId = id else DowmSkins.batId = id end
pcall(function() saveAllSettings() end)
end
return ok
end
local restoring = false
function DowmSkins.applySaved()
if restoring then return end
if DowmSkins.batId == nil and DowmSkins.medusaId == nil then return end
restoring = true
task.spawn(function()
local deadline = os.clock() + 30
local batDone = (DowmSkins.batId == nil)
local medDone = (DowmSkins.medusaId == nil)
while os.clock() < deadline and not (batDone and medDone) do
if not batDone then
local t = findTool("Bat")
if t then batDone = applyAssetToTool(t, DowmSkins.batId) == true end
end
if not medDone then
local t = findTool("Medusa's Head")
if t then medDone = applyAssetToTool(t, DowmSkins.medusaId) == true end
end
task.wait(0.6)
end
restoring = false
end)
end
task.spawn(function()
task.wait(2.5)
DowmSkins.applySaved()
end)
LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
task.wait(1.4)
DowmSkins.applySaved()
end)
end
DONW_HUB_FONT = nil
function loadDownHubFont()
local fontAssetGetter = getcustomasset or getsynasset
if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(fontAssetGetter) ~= "function" then return end
local fontPath, jsonPath = "Monter_Duels_Starborn.ttf", "Monter_Duels_Starborn.json"
local fontReady = false
if type(isfile) == "function" then pcall(function() fontReady = isfile(fontPath) end) end
if not fontReady then
local okDownload, data = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet("https://files.catbox.moe/pwgdui.ttf") end)
if not okDownload or type(data) ~= "string" or #data < 1000 then return end
if not pcall(writefile, fontPath, data) then return end
end
local okAsset, fontAsset = pcall(fontAssetGetter, fontPath)
if not okAsset or not fontAsset then return end
local okJson = pcall(function()
writefile(jsonPath, game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({name = "Starborn", faces = {{name = "Regular", weight = 400, style = "normal", assetId = fontAsset}}}))
end)
if not okJson then return end
local okJsonAsset, jsonAsset = pcall(fontAssetGetter, jsonPath)
if not okJsonAsset or not jsonAsset then return end
local okFont, customFont = pcall(function() return Font.new(jsonAsset) end)
if not okFont or not customFont then return end
DONW_HUB_FONT = customFont
end
function applyDownHubFont(root)
if not DONW_HUB_FONT or not root then return end
local function apply(obj)
if obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox") then
pcall(function() obj.FontFace = DONW_HUB_FONT end)
end
end
apply(root)
for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do apply(d) end
end

local particlesHolder = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
particlesHolder.Name = "ParticlesHolder"
